creative_direction: Create a copper ribbon pedestrian bridge across a shallow canal. The bridge deck and rail form one continuous folded band, with the highest curve below the upper fifth. Show fine metal seams and a soft reflection beneath, avoiding exaggerated shine. Low grasses and pale stone abutments anchor the span. Keep the sky clear and omit people, boats, and signs. Use precise architectural landscape. Vertical 1024x1536 wallpaper; reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet sky or light, with no text, logo, or watermark.
